findings.finding: Adding the engine to the outer `review` condition sends a non-pipeline engine into the `else: passthrough` arm, even when the floor passed (run_llm true). That arm returns precheck's verdict, which is the floor-block/exempt result. So under a non-pipeline engine, a plan that passed the floor would silently get that verdict instead of a review. In this ticket the change is also dead code, because `agentic` raises in review_plan before the workflow runs. It only becomes reachable, and wrong, once the next ticket removes the raise.
scenarios: The follow-up ticket removes the raise. With engine=agentic and a floor-passing plan, the condition is false, passthrough emits the precheck verdict, and nothing tells the user the review never ran.
